Integrates TemplateFlow standardized template access supports interactive brain surface visualisation via triangle-mesh rendering 'ggplot2' 'ggiraph'. neuroatlas package provides unified interface access work various neuroimaging atlases parcellations. includes support cortical atlases (Schaefer, Glasser), subcortical segmentations (FreeSurfer ASEG), FSL/TemplateFlow structural atlases (Harvard-Oxford, Julich-Brain), specialized atlases (Olsen MTL). package integrates TemplateFlow standardized template access supports interactive brain surface visualisation via triangle-mesh rendering.

text: dilate_atlas() now genuinely honours radius argument. previous implementation passed fixed k Rnanoflann::nn(search = "radius"), returns k nearest neighbours regardless distance, radius effect dilation filled entire mask (absorbing, cortical atlas, distant cerebellar deep subcortical grey matter). Dilation now uses standard k-NN search explicit Euclidean radius cutoff: -mask voxels parcel within radius voxels left unassigned. behaviour change — callers relied old whole-mask fill now get radius-limited results. See new “Dilating Atlas Cover Grey Matter” vignette. Added get_harvard_oxford_atlas() registry entries Harvard-Oxford cortical, subcortical, combined structural parcellations. default source TemplateFlow, threshold resolution options maximum-probability dseg images. Added get_fsl_atlas() FSL XML-described atlases, including documented offset probabilistic XML label indices max-probability summary image label values. Added thin FSL-backed wrapper Julich-Brain / Brodmann-style cytoarchitectonic labels (get_julich_brain_atlas()), now downloads Nilearn/NITRC Juelich.tgz archive local FSL-style cache FSLDIR unset. plot_brain(overlay = <NeuroVol>) now propagates missing data volume--surface projection: vertices fall outside input volume’s coverage (whose neighbourhood contains finite source voxel) emitted NA rather 0. Added canonical new_atlas() / new_surfatlas() constructor assembles every loader’s return value (Schaefer, Glasser, ASEG, Olsen MTL / hippocampus, TemplateFlow subcortical). constructor validates required fields typed neuroatlas_error_invalid_atlas condition, normalises RGB colour maps data frame, builds roi_metadata uniformly, attaches atlas_ref / provenance one place — removing ~100 lines per-loader boilerplate. Added lightweight atlas registry (register_atlas()) exposed via two new public helpers: list_atlases() enumerates built-atlases, get_atlas(name, ...) dispatches registered loader id alias (e.g. get_atlas("schaefer2018", parcels="100", networks="7")). Added centralised download helpers (.neuroatlas_download(), .neuroatlas_try_download()) used Schaefer Glasser loaders. Failures now raise classed neuroatlas_error_download conditions upstream URL instead returning silent NULL; Git LFS pointer stubs detected reported explicitly. Atlas loaders now emit cli::cli_abort() / cli::cli_warn() structured classes (neuroatlas_error_*, neuroatlas_warn_*) place bare stop() / warning(), callers can catch loader errors class.
